text: Harness: context compiler that injects mission path, hypotheses, reflections and similar or cancelled ideas into the prompt
description: One pure function compileContext(ideaId, stage, tokenBudget) -> prompt sections, replacing the ad-hoc promptText assembly in loop-worker runCycle. Sections, ranked and trimmed to budget: the idea; mission path to root with each edge's hypothesis; siblings and their states; children briefs; semantically similar ideas, cancelled/failed ones with their reasons first; reflections on connections of similar ideas ('this kind of bet held/failed'); recent loop events and human messages. Stage-specific: decompose gets siblings and cancelled lookalikes, execute gets code pointers and the acceptance evidence, verify gets only idea + diff + claimed evidence. Unit-testable without a model.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: As memory grows, similarity alone fills the context budget with items that never helped; usefulness weighting keeps the context small and effective.

status.comment: packages/loop-worker/src/context.ts compileContext(input, stage, budgetChars): pure, sections idea (+ status comment, cost, facts, the bet on each parent), human messages, mission path root-first with each edge's 'because' hypothesis, children with bets and outcomes, cancelled/failed lookalikes with their reasons, siblings, lessons (hypothesis + reflection on similar ideas' edges), other similar ideas, recent loop events. Ranked per stage (decompose puts siblings early, execute late), the crossing section is cut and the rest dropped, budget default 48k chars. Replaces the JSON dump in cycle.ts for decompose and execute; each stage logs context size, included and dropped sections. Verify keeps its narrow idea+claim+status+diff prompt. Code pointers are left to the code_intelligence tool. Evidence: context.test.ts (content and budget/ranking), loop-worker 20/20; compiled on the real graph for this idea via the dev backend: 5216 chars, mission path with hypotheses and the stage-machine reflection as a lesson.
